newsitem.title: USA: Republicans renominate Gingrich as House speaker.
newsitem.headline: Republicans renominate Gingrich as House speaker.

text.p: House Republicans Wednesday renominated Newt Gingrich to be speaker of the U.S. House for a second term beginning next January.
Gingrich, accepting the nomination, said it was a bittersweet day for him because his stepfather, Robert Gingrich, died Tuesday night.
Gingrich was approved unanimously without opposition on a voice vote by Republicans elected to the House of Representatives Nov. 5.
He is considered certain to be elected speaker by the full House when the next session of Congress convenes Jan. 2.
The vote is normally along straight party lines, and Republicans will have a majority of at least 20 seats in the next House.
The only threat to Gingrich's re-election could come if the House Ethics Committee makes damaging charges against him in a report expected to be issued before the end of the year.
